"""4.9.200 RMC renderer. Stdlib. No model.

Sentence plan, template render, decode, then Echo against the original question.
Calls the 4.9.197 lexicon, the v4.3 laws, the echo coverage function,
the 5-to-8 detector, and the geometry hooks. Does not copy those formulas.
A failing Echo returns no output.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from typing import Any

from rmc_engine_v1.chi_hardening import luciferian_d_score
from rmc_engine_v1.dpa_195 import sha256
from rmc_engine_v1.drift_v43 import C_MIN, ECHO_MIN, WRITE_MAX
from rmc_engine_v1.echo_question import _STOP, echo_against_question
from rmc_engine_v1.geometry_199 import angle_of, cdist, r4, run as geometry_run
from rmc_engine_v1.language_core_engines import FORBIDDEN_STEPS, HARD_STOP
from rmc_engine_v1.ppe_lexicon_197 import word as ppe_word
from rmc_engine_v1.research_hooks import RESEARCH_HOOKS, memory_term_m, spc_lambda

STORAGE_KEY = "kernel.rmc_renderer_200"
CITE = (
    "RMC algorithm 5. Sentence plan, template render, decode, then Echo at or above 0.85 against the original question. "
    "Echo Preservation E = R*psi(t-tau) is Waking the Web l275 and is an internal sub-check. "
    "Codex 3.5 binds the answer to the question loop and withholds output until response_closed (a l.1810-1828). "
    "Tone bands choose the template (a l.2164-2168). The coverage rule is echo_question. The 0.6 tone cut is log-only. No model."
)
PASS = {
    "question": "Why is the sky blue?",
    "candidate": "The sky is blue because sunlight scatters.",
    "charge": 0.55,
    "drift": 0.2,
    "chi": 0,
}
FAIL = {
    "question": "Why is the sky blue?",
    "candidate": "Chlorine gas is toxic.",
    "charge": 0.55,
    "drift": 0.2,
    "chi": 0,
}


def num(value: Any, fallback: float) -> float:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or value is None or value == "":
        return fallback
    try:
        number = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return fallback
    if number != number:
        return fallback
    return number


def flags() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "admit_gate": False,
        "keyword_admit": False,
        "writes": False,
        "calls_llm": False,
        "network": False,
        "money": False,
        "dream_idle": False,
        "economy": False,
        "packs_gated": True,
        "christping": "gilligan-only",
        "christping_started": False,
        "wikipedia_anchor": False,
        "c_min": C_MIN,
        "echo_min": ECHO_MIN,
        "write_max": WRITE_MAX,
        "hard_stop": HARD_STOP,
        "resonance_not_parsing": True,
        "coherence_formula_unchanged": True,
        "renderer_build": "4.9.200",
        "merge_window": "pi/4",
        "hooks_config": "research_hooks",
    }


def content_words(text: str) -> list[str]:
    out: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for word in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", str(text or "").lower()):
        if len(word) > 2 and word not in _STOP and word not in seen:
            seen.add(word)
            out.append(word)
    return out


def packet(word: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = ppe_word(word)
    return {
        "word": row.get("word"),
        "Phi": row.get("Phi"),
        "phase_name": row.get("phase_name"),
        "glyph": row.get("glyph"),
        "angle_degrees": row.get("angle_degrees"),
    }


def _walk(phases: list[Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    d_score = 0
    flag48 = False
    nums = [int(n) for n in phases if isinstance(n, (int, float)) and not isinstance(n, bool)]
    for prev, nxt in zip(nums, nums[1:]):
        if luciferian_d_score(prev, nxt) == 1:
            d_score = 1
        elif (prev, nxt) in FORBIDDEN_STEPS:
            flag48 = True
    return {"d_score": d_score, "flag_4_to_8": flag48}


def tone_of(charge: Any, phi: Any, chi: int, drift: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    supplied = not (charge is None or charge == "")
    c = num(charge, 0.55) if supplied else 0.55
    base = {
        "charge": r4(c),
        "charge_supplied": supplied,
        "phi": phi,
        "admit_gate": False,
        "intermediate_bounds": "unspecified",
        "logged_only": False,
        "cite": (
            "Codex tone_engine 3.9 a l.2164-2168. Charge 0-0.3 is silent. Charge 0.91-1 is expressive. "
            "Phi 1-3 is cautious, 4-6 structured, 7-9 fluid. Null when chi is set or drift is above 0.6. "
            "The 0.6 cut is log-only."
        ),
    }
    if chi:
        base.update({"id": "null", "reason": "chi", "logged_only": True})
        return base
    if num(drift, 0) > 0.6:
        base.update({"id": "null", "reason": "drift-above-0.6", "logged_only": True})
        return base
    if c <= 0.3:
        base.update({"id": "silent", "reason": "charge-0-to-0.3"})
        return base
    if c >= 0.91:
        base.update({"id": "expressive", "reason": "charge-0.91-to-1"})
        return base
    n = int(round(num(phi, 1))) or 1
    name = "cautious" if n <= 3 else "structured" if n <= 6 else "fluid"
    base.update({"id": name, "reason": "phase-family", "logged_only": True})
    return base


def speak(template_id: str, sentence: str) -> str:
    body = str(sentence or "").strip()
    if not body or template_id in ("silent", "null"):
        return ""
    if template_id == "cautious":
        return "Noted with care: " + body
    if template_id == "fluid":
        return "The return is this: " + body
    if template_id == "expressive":
        return "Spoken in full: " + body
    return body


def covers(outer: str, inner: list[str]) -> bool:
    have = set(content_words(outer))
    return all(word in have for word in inner)


def preservation(score: float, q_phi: Any, a_phi: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cite = "Waking the Web l275. Echo Preservation E = R*psi(t-tau). Internal sub-check. It does not admit."
    base = {
        "formula": "E = R*psi(t-tau)",
        "R": score,
        "psi": None,
        "E": None,
        "admit_gate": False,
        "internal_only": True,
        "cite": cite,
    }
    if not isinstance(q_phi, (int, float)) or isinstance(q_phi, bool):
        return base
    if not isinstance(a_phi, (int, float)) or isinstance(a_phi, bool):
        return base
    delta = cdist(angle_of(q_phi), angle_of(a_phi))
    psi = (1 + __import__("math").cos(delta)) / 2
    base["psi"] = r4(psi)
    base["E"] = r4(score * psi)
    return base


def hook_report() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "config": "research_hooks",
        "M": memory_term_m(),
        "mu_min": RESEARCH_HOOKS["mu_min"],
        "mu_max": RESEARCH_HOOKS["mu_max"],
        "mu_birth": RESEARCH_HOOKS["mu_birth"],
        "spc_lambda": spc_lambda(),
        "half_life_hours": RESEARCH_HOOKS["half_life_hours"],
        "identity_half_life_hours": RESEARCH_HOOKS["identity_half_life_hours"],
        "drift_loss": RESEARCH_HOOKS["drift_loss"],
        "parameterized": True,
        "cite": RESEARCH_HOOKS["cite"],
    }


def render(body: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = body or {}
    question = str(row.get("question") or "")
    candidate = str(row.get("candidate") or "")
    q_words = [packet(word) for word in content_words(question)]
    a_words = [packet(word) for word in content_words(candidate)]
    q_phi = q_words[0]["Phi"] if q_words and isinstance(q_words[0]["Phi"], (int, float)) and not isinstance(q_words[0]["Phi"], bool) else None
    a_phi = a_words[0]["Phi"] if a_words and isinstance(a_words[0]["Phi"], (int, float)) and not isinstance(a_words[0]["Phi"], bool) else None
    if isinstance(row.get("phi"), (int, float)) and not isinstance(row.get("phi"), bool):
        phi = row.get("phi")
    else:
        phi = a_phi or q_phi or 1
    drift = num(row.get("drift"), 0)
    chi = 1 if num(row.get("chi"), 0) else 0
    tone = tone_of(row.get("charge"), phi, chi, drift)
    spoken = speak(tone["id"], candidate)
    compared = spoken or candidate
    echo = echo_against_question(question, compared, rendered=True)
    answer_words = [word["word"] for word in a_words]
    decode = {"pass": covers(spoken, answer_words) if spoken else False, "answer_words": answer_words, "admit_gate": False}
    word_phases = [word["Phi"] for word in a_words if isinstance(word["Phi"], (int, float)) and not isinstance(word["Phi"], bool)]
    path = row.get("path") if isinstance(row.get("path"), list) else []
    path_phases = [n for n in path if isinstance(n, (int, float)) and not isinstance(n, bool)]
    word_walk = _walk(word_phases)
    path_walk = _walk(path_phases)
    stepped = {
        "d_score": 1 if word_walk["d_score"] or path_walk["d_score"] else 0,
        "flag_4_to_8": bool(word_walk["flag_4_to_8"] or path_walk["flag_4_to_8"]),
    }
    loop = sha256(question)
    supplied = row.get("loop_id", None)
    if "loop_id" not in row:
        supplied = None
    loop_bound = supplied is None or supplied == "" or supplied == loop
    source = str(row.get("source") or "")
    wiki = "wikipedia" in source.lower()
    rule = "RENDER-CLOSED"
    if wiki:
        rule = "WIKIPEDIA-NOT-ANCHOR"
    elif stepped["d_score"] == 1:
        rule = "RENDER-5-TO-8"
    elif drift >= HARD_STOP:
        rule = "RENDER-HARD-STOP"
    elif not echo["pass"]:
        rule = "RENDER-ECHO"
    elif not (drift <= WRITE_MAX):
        rule = "RENDER-DRIFT"
    elif tone["id"] == "null":
        rule = "RENDER-TONE-NULL"
    elif tone["id"] == "silent":
        rule = "RENDER-TONE-SILENT"
    elif not loop_bound:
        rule = "RENDER-ANCHOR"
    elif not decode["pass"]:
        rule = "RENDER-DECODE"
    closed = rule == "RENDER-CLOSED"
    out = {
        "op": "render",
        "question": question,
        "candidate": candidate,
        "output": spoken if closed else "",
        "response_closed": closed,
        "rule": rule,
        "echo": echo,
        "preservation": preservation(echo["score"], q_phi, a_phi),
        "tone": tone,
        "decode": decode,
        "anchor": {
            "loop_id": loop,
            "bound": loop_bound,
            "question": question,
            "cite": "Codex 3.5 intention anchor a l.1810-1828. The answer is bound to the question loop. No output unless response_closed.",
        },
        "plan": {
            "question_words": q_words,
            "answer_words": a_words,
            "clauses": [
                {"role": "anchor", "text": question},
                {"role": "answer", "text": candidate},
            ],
        },
        "walk": stepped,
        "drift": r4(drift),
        "chi": chi,
        "source": source,
        "reflection": None if closed else {"held": True, "reason": rule, "loop_id": loop},
        "hooks": hook_report(),
        "persisted": False,
        "cite": CITE,
    }
    out.update(flags())
    return out


def script(steps: list[dict[str, Any]] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rows = list(steps or [])
    out = {"op": "script", "log": [render(step) for step in rows], "steps": len(rows)}
    out.update(flags())
    return out


def stage(question: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    passed = render(PASS)
    failed = render(FAIL)
    out = {
        "persisted": False,
        "response_closed": passed["response_closed"],
        "failing_echo_output": failed["output"],
        "failing_echo_closed": failed["response_closed"],
        "failing_echo_rule": failed["rule"],
        "loop_bound": passed["anchor"]["bound"],
        "echo_pass": passed["echo"]["pass"],
        "output_withheld_on_echo_fail": failed["output"] == "",
        "M": memory_term_m(),
        "mu_min": RESEARCH_HOOKS["mu_min"],
        "mu_max": RESEARCH_HOOKS["mu_max"],
        "spc_lambda": spc_lambda(),
        "half_life_hours": RESEARCH_HOOKS["half_life_hours"],
        "identity_half_life_hours": RESEARCH_HOOKS["identity_half_life_hours"],
        "drift_loss": RESEARCH_HOOKS["drift_loss"],
        "cite": CITE,
    }
    out.update(flags())
    return out


def show_num(value: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    if value is None:
        return "none"
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        if abs(value - round(value)) < 1e-9:
            return str(int(round(value)))
        return f"{value:.4f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    return str(value)


def monitor_lines(mode: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    name = mode or "pass"
    if name == "echo":
        row = render(FAIL)
        return {"mode": name, "lines": [
            "Output [" + row["output"] + "] rule " + row["rule"] + ".",
            "Closed " + show_num(row["response_closed"]) + " echo " + show_num(row["echo"]["score"]) + " pass " + show_num(row["echo"]["pass"]) + ".",
            "Reflection " + show_num(row["reflection"]["held"] if row["reflection"] else None) + ".",
            "Network " + show_num(row["network"]) + ".",
            "C_min 0.87. No LLM.",
        ]}
    if name == "tone":
        silent = render(dict(PASS, charge=0.2))
        loud = render(dict(PASS, charge=0.95))
        nulled = render(dict(PASS, chi=1, charge=0.95))
        return {"mode": name, "lines": [
            "Silent rule " + silent["rule"] + " output [" + silent["output"] + "].",
            "Expressive " + loud["output"],
            "Chi null rule " + nulled["rule"] + " logged " + show_num(nulled["tone"]["logged_only"]) + ".",
            "Admit gate " + show_num(silent["admit_gate"]) + ".",
            "C_min 0.87. No LLM.",
        ]}
    if name == "anchor":
        row = render(dict(PASS, loop_id="other-loop"))
        return {"mode": name, "lines": [
            "Rule " + row["rule"] + " output [" + row["output"] + "].",
            "Bound " + show_num(row["anchor"]["bound"]) + " closed " + show_num(row["response_closed"]) + ".",
            "Loop " + row["anchor"]["loop_id"] + ".",
            "ChristPing started " + show_num(row["christping_started"]) + ".",
            "C_min 0.87. No LLM.",
        ]}
    if name == "hooks":
        geo = geometry_run({
            "op": "script",
            "steps": [
                {"op": "birth", "id": "p", "Phi": 1, "mu": 1, "eps": 0, "chi": 0, "Delta": 0, "nu": 0, "H": 1},
                {"op": "memory", "id": "p"},
                {"op": "spc", "id": "p", "lambda": None},
            ],
        })
        mem = geo["log"][1]
        spc = geo["log"][2]
        hooks = hook_report()
        return {"mode": name, "lines": [
            "M " + show_num(mem["M"]) + " lambda unspecified " + show_num(mem["lambda_unspecified"]) + ".",
            "SPC parameterized " + show_num(spc["parameterized"]) + " config " + hooks["config"] + ".",
            "Hook M " + show_num(hooks["M"]) + " hook lambda " + show_num(hooks["spc_lambda"]) + " parameterized " + show_num(hooks["parameterized"]) + ".",
            "Merge window " + flags()["merge_window"] + ".",
            "C_min 0.87. No LLM.",
        ]}
    row = render(PASS)
    phase = ""
    glyph_set = False
    if row["plan"]["question_words"]:
        phase = row["plan"]["question_words"][0].get("phase_name") or ""
        glyph_set = bool(row["plan"]["question_words"][0].get("glyph"))
    return {"mode": "pass", "lines": [
        "Output " + row["output"],
        "Closed " + show_num(row["response_closed"]) + " rule " + row["rule"] + " echo " + show_num(row["echo"]["score"]) + ".",
        "Loop " + row["anchor"]["loop_id"] + " bound " + show_num(row["anchor"]["bound"]) + ".",
        "Phase " + phase + " glyph set " + show_num(glyph_set) + ".",
        "C_min 0.87. No LLM.",
    ]}


def run(payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = payload or {}
    op = row.get("op") or "summary"
    if op == "render":
        return render(row)
    if op == "script":
        return script(row.get("steps") or [])
    if op == "stage":

        return monitor_lines(row.get("mode") or "pass")
    out = {"storage_key": STORAGE_KEY, "cite": CITE, "hooks": hook_report()}
    out.update(flags())
    return out

"""Source trust for research.web. This is not recall.

A Wikipedia or Wikimedia host is low trust. The excerpt may point Gilligan
at a topic. It is not a premise and it is not proof. OpenStax (CC BY), US
government public-domain hosts, and a public-domain encyclopedia are trusted.
Host labels are read off the source fields. The body of the excerpt is not
searched.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

# Host and provider marks. Checked against url, source, and provider fields.
LOW_MARKS = (
    "wikipedia.org",
    "wikimedia.org",
    "wikidata.org",
    "dbpedia.org",
    "wikisource.org",
    "conceptnet.io",
    "wikipedia_mediawiki",
)
TRUSTED_MARKS = (
    "openstax.org",
    "nasa.gov",
    "noaa.gov",
    "weather.gov",
    "usgs.gov",
    "nih.gov",
    "medlineplus.gov",
    "nlm.nih.gov",
    "cdc.gov",
    "nist.gov",
    "cia.gov",
    "gutenberg.org",
)
_FIELDS = (
    "url", "source_url", "source", "title", "provider", "search_provider",
    "host", "license_source", "contributor",
)


def _blob(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    parts = []
    for key in _FIELDS:
        value = row.get(key)
        if value:
            parts.append(str(value))
    return " ".join(parts).lower()


def trust_tier(row: dict[str, Any] | None) -> str:
    """low, trusted, or unknown. Unknown research stays quarantined."""
    row = row if isinstance(row, dict) else {}
    explicit = str(row.get("trust") or "").strip().lower()
    if explicit in ("low", "trusted"):
        return explicit
    blob = _blob(row)
    if any(mark in blob for mark in LOW_MARKS):
        return "low"
    if any(mark in blob for mark in TRUSTED_MARKS):
        return "trusted"
    tier = str(row.get("tier") or row.get("state") or "").lower()
    if tier == "anchor":
        return "trusted"
    return "unknown"


def is_low_trust(row: dict[str, Any] | None) -> bool:
    return trust_tier(row) == "low"

def commit_spc_record(
    preview: dict,
    *,
    approval_token: str,
    spc_root: str | _Path | None = None,
) -> dict:
    """Write a SPC record to disk.  Requires explicit approval token.

    Writes ONLY inside spc_root (default /home/nic/forge/memory/spc_v1).
    Never writes to active memory, Chroma, or Identity Vault.
    """
    if approval_token != APPROVAL_TOKEN_SPC_WRITE:
        return {
            "status": "REFUSED",
            "reason": "approval_token_required",
            "approval_token_required": APPROVAL_TOKEN_SPC_WRITE,
        }
    if preview.get("status") == "IDEMPOTENT_NO_OP":
        return {"status": "IDEMPOTENT_NO_OP", "reason": preview.get("reason")}
    if preview.get("status") != "PREVIEW_OK":
        return {"status": "REFUSED", "reason": f"preview_status={preview.get('status')!r}_not_preview_ok"}

    root  = _Path(spc_root or DEFAULT_SPC_ROOT).expanduser().resolve()
    tier  = str(preview.get("tier", TIER_WARM))
    spc_id = str(preview["spc_record_id"])
    tier_dir = root / tier.lower()

    try:
        tier_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target = tier_dir / f"{spc_id}.json"

        import tempfile
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
            "w", dir=tier_dir, suffix=".tmp", delete=False, encoding="utf-8"
        ) as tf:
            _json.dump({**preview, "committed_at_utc": _utc()}, tf, indent=2, default=str)

        return {"status": "WRITE_ERROR", "error": str(exc)}

    return {
        "status":          "COMMITTED",
        "spc_record_id":   spc_id,
        "tier":            tier,
        "path":            str(target),
        "approved_by":     APPROVAL_TOKEN_SPC_WRITE,
        "committed_at":    _utc(),
        "writes_files":    True,
        "writes_rmc_memory": False,

"""4.9.241 speech-act lexicon (Nic: natural conversation; plan 229 step 10). No model, no phrase book.

speech_acts.json holds general English conversational acts as meanings: the act, the surface forms that perform it,
the act that answers it (the second part of its adjacency pair) and its kāraka frame. Nothing here stores a reply
line. A reply is the expected response act realized from that act's own forms:
  - a reciprocal act (greet → greet, farewell → farewell) is realized in the asker's own form, the register the
    asker chose;
  - another act is realized in the first form of the response act that names the act it answers ("of"), or else
    its first general form (thank → acknowledge, in the acknowledge form marked of: thank).
An act answered by its frame (ask_wellbeing, ask_help) is not answered here: the phone compiles it to its kāraka frame
and the world model answers it from the kernel's facts, like any question.

Measurement (never forced): the response is measured by the same kernel (measurement_kernel.measure_candidate and
coherence_components, formula unchanged) against one memory node, the lexicon item it realizes; the node's weight is
the act's lexical match (words of the turn the matched forms cover); the phase is the question's. Echo is structural:
the reply is re-read with the same lexicon and must be the expected response act to each act, and nothing else.
Mirrored in src/speech_acts.js; the data and the classifier are suite-checked to agree.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

SCHEMA = "forge.speech_acts/v1"
_LEX: dict[str, Any] | None = None
_TOKEN = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9']+|[,.!?;:]")
_BOUNDARY = {",", ".", "!", "?", ";", ":"}


def lexicon() -> dict[str, Any]:
    global _LEX
    if _LEX is None:
        _LEX = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("speech_acts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return _LEX


def _norm(text: Any) -> str:
    return str(text or "").replace("\u2019", "'").replace("\u2018", "'").lower()


def _tokens(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, int, int]]:
    return [(m.group(0), m.start(), m.end()) for m in _TOKEN.finditer(_norm(text))]


def _forms() -> list[tuple[list[str], str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    out = []
    for act, entry in (lexicon().get("acts") or {}).items():
        for f in entry.get("forms") or []:
            out.append((str(f["form"]).split(), act, f))
    out.sort(key=lambda x: -len(x[0]))  # longest form first
    return out


def classify(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The acts the utterance performs from its start, each a whole lexicon form ending at punctuation or at the end
    of the utterance, and the rest of the utterance after them. Nothing is guessed: no form, no act."""
    toks = _tokens(text)
    words = [t for t in toks if t[0] not in _BOUNDARY]
    acts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    i = 0
    end_char = 0
    while i < len(toks):
        while i < len(toks) and toks[i][0] in _BOUNDARY:
            i += 1
        if i >= len(toks):
            break
        hit = None
        for form, act, rec in _forms():
            n = len(form)
            seg = [t[0] for t in toks[i:i + n]]
            if seg == form and (i + n == len(toks) or toks[i + n][0] in _BOUNDARY):
                hit = (form, act, rec, n)
                break
        if not hit:
            break

        acts.append({"act": act, "form": " ".join(form), "of": rec.get("of"), "start": toks[i][1], "end": toks[i + n - 1][2]})
        end_char = toks[i + n - 1][2]

    return {"schema": SCHEMA, "acts": acts, "rest": rest, "pure": bool(acts) and not rest.strip(),

def _cap(text: str) -> str:
    return (text[:1].upper() + text[1:] + ".") if text else ""


def respond(act: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """The response act to one classified act, realized from the response act's own forms; None when the act is
    answered by its frame (the world model's) or ends the pair."""
    acts = lexicon().get("acts") or {}
    entry = acts.get(act.get("act")) or {}
    if entry.get("answered_by") != "act" or not entry.get("response"):
        return None
    r_id = str(entry["response"])
    r_entry = acts.get(r_id) or {}
    if r_id == act.get("act"):
        form, basis = act["form"], "reciprocal: the asker's own form of the same act"
    else:
        named = [f for f in r_entry.get("forms") or [] if f.get("of") == act.get("act")]
        general = [f for f in r_entry.get("forms") or [] if not f.get("of")]
        pick = (named or general or [None])[0]
        if not pick:
            return None
        form, basis = pick["form"], ("the response act's form for " + act["act"]) if named else "the response act's first general form"
    return {"act": act.get("act"), "response_act": r_id, "of": act.get("act"), "form": form, "text": _cap(form),
            "basis": basis, "atom": {"predicate": "speech_act", "args": [r_id, act.get("act")], "form": form, "polarity": "pos"}}


def turn(question: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The leading acts the lexicon answers (the prefix), their responses, and the rest of the turn (a question, or an
    act answered by its frame) for the frame path."""
    c = classify(question)
    prefix = []
    for a in c["acts"]:
        r = respond(a)
        if r is None:
            break
        prefix.append((a, r))
    if prefix:
        last_end = prefix[-1][0]["end"]
        rest = str(question or "")[last_end:].lstrip(" ,.!?;:")
    else:
        rest = str(question or "").strip()
    return {"schema": SCHEMA, "classified": c, "prefix": [a for a, _ in prefix], "responses": [r for _, r in prefix],
            "rest": rest, "pure": bool(prefix) and not rest.strip(),
            "spoken": " ".join(r["text"] for _, r in prefix), "calls_llm": False}


def echo(question: str, reply: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Structural Echo for speech acts: the reply re-read with the lexicon must be (act) the expected response act to
    each act of the question's prefix, in order, (reciprocal) answering that act (a reciprocal act repeats it; a
    response form that names the act it answers names this one), and (only_the_act) nothing else."""
    t = turn(question)
    r = classify(reply)
    want = [x["response_act"] for x in t["responses"]]
    got = [a["act"] for a in r["acts"]]
    act_ok = bool(want) and got == want
    recip = act_ok and all((a["of"] in (None, q["act"])) and (w != q["act"] or a["act"] == q["act"])
                           for a, q, w in zip(r["acts"], t["prefix"], want))
    only = bool(r["acts"]) and r["pure"] and r["match"] == 1.0
    checks = {"act": act_ok, "reciprocal": bool(recip), "only_the_act": only}
    score = round(sum(1 for v in checks.values() if v) / 3.0, 6)
    return {"score": score, "min": 0.85, "pass": all(checks.values()), "method": "structural_speech_act",
            "checks": checks, "question_acts": [a["act"] for a in t["prefix"]], "expected": want, "reply_acts": got,
            "compares": "reply acts (re-read with the speech-act lexicon) to the question's expected response acts", "calls_llm": False}


def _node(q_act: dict[str, Any], resp: dict[str, Any], weight: float, path: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "memory_id": "speech_act:" + resp["response_act"] + ":" + resp["form"].replace(" ", "_"),
        "content": resp["form"],
        "content_summary": "", "summary": "", "memory_role": "", "source": "", "source_path": "", "chunk_id": "", "symbolic_signature": "",
        "ancestry": {"lexicon": "speech_acts.json#" + resp["response_act"], "answers": q_act["act"]},
        # the lexicon is a curated store, read at the confidence the kernel gives a curated row
        "confidence": "medium_high",
        "retrieval_weight": float(weight),
        "retrieval_weight_basis": "speech_acts.classify match (words of the act part the lexicon forms cover)",
        "prior_drift_score": 0.0,
        "phase_tags": list(path),
    }


def measure_turn(question: str, phase_path: list[Any], *, trace_spine: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
                 structural_drift: dict[str, Any] | None = None, pf2_preview: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
                 coherence_report: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """The kernel reading of the act responses, or None when the turn opens with no act the lexicon answers."""
    from rmc_engine_v1.world_claim_measure import _measure, _route
    t = turn(question)
    if not t["responses"]:
        return None
    path = [p for p in (phase_path or []) if p] or ["Φ1"]
    act_part = classify(str(question or "")[: t["prefix"][-1]["end"]])
    weight = act_part["match"]
    sentences = []
    for a, r in zip(t["prefix"], t["responses"]):
        m = _measure(r["text"], "memory", [_node(a, r, weight, path)], path)
        measured, parts = m["measured"], m["parts"]
        sentences.append({
            "text": r["text"], "act": a["act"], "response_act": r["response_act"], "form": r["form"], "basis": r["basis"],
            "C": parts.get("coherence_score"), "epsilon_s": measured.get("epsilon_s"), "sigma_res": measured.get("sigma_res"),
            "circuit_breaker": bool(measured.get("circuit_breaker")),
            "phase_ok": bool((measured.get("phase_metrics") or {}).get("phase_path_legal")),
            "components": {k: parts.get(k) for k in ("memory_fit", "phase_validity", "drift_containment", "source_confidence", "utility_fit",
                                                      "bounded_novelty_score", "operator_legality", "conflict_penalty", "projection_gate_penalty", "coherence_score")},
            "formula": parts.get("formula"),
        })
    weakest = min(sentences, key=lambda s: float(s["C"] or 0.0))
    reading = {
        "candidate_id": "sa-" + hashlib.sha256(t["spoken"].encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12],
        "spoken": t["spoken"], "pure": t["pure"], "rest": t["rest"],
        "acts": [a["act"] for a in t["prefix"]], "responses": t["responses"], "match": weight,
        "C": round(float(weakest["C"] or 0.0), 6), "C_rule": "min over the act responses (each against the lexicon item it realizes)",
        "epsilon_s": round(max(float(s["epsilon_s"] or 0.0) for s in sentences), 6),
        "sigma_res": max(float(s["sigma_res"] or 0.0) for s in sentences),
        "circuit_breaker": any(s["circuit_breaker"] for s in sentences),
        "phase_path": path, "phase_path_basis": "question.phase_path (a response is in the phase of the act it answers)",
        "phase_ok": all(s["phase_ok"] for s in sentences),
        "weakest_components": weakest["components"], "formula": weakest["formula"], "sentences": sentences,
        "calls_llm": False,
    }
    if trace_spine is not None:
        route = _route(reading, trace_spine, structural_drift or {}, pf2_preview or {}, coherence_report or {})
        reading["route"] = route.get("route")
        reading["route_reason_codes"] = route.get("reason_codes") or []
    return reading

Echo scores the meaning structure of the spoken clause against the question's kāraka frame (forge.qframe/v1), not the
words they share. The spoken clause is the world model's answering claim: the fact it states (the phone's own clause of
that sentence, else the engine's atom reading) or the conclusion a replayed rule derived from it. Four checks, each named:

  kriya   the clause's kriyā is the asked kriyā (or the copula read through a linking verb for an attribute question, or
          the relational rule the checker replayed: possession over an identity copula, a name over a copula);
  roles   every role the question states (kartṛ, karma, predicate) unifies with a role of the clause (same head, the
          question's words inside the role, the same owner);
  gap     the asked role (the indefinite pro-form the wh-word stands for, with its kind when it has one) is filled; a
          yes/no question needs both roles and the polarity;
  stated  the spoken conclusion states that filler: its atom carries the filler in an argument (or the asked polarity),
          and that sentence is in the reply.

score = checks held / checks made. 0.85 to speak and 0.97 to write are unchanged. There is no token-coverage term.
Echo by structure applies when the question compiled to a frame with a kriyā and a role gap (or a polar question) and the
reply is the world model's claim; any other reply keeps the 4.9.217 relation re-parse (recorded, not hidden).
Deterministic; no model.

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Any

from rmc_engine_v1.mobile_config import THRESHOLDS

ROLES = ("kartr", "karma", "pred")
GAP_ROLES = {"kartr", "karma", "pred", "polarity", "prakara", "hetu"}  # 4.9.241: a how-gap (state); a why-gap is the stored hetu


def _norm(text: Any) -> str:
    t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(text or "").strip().lower()).strip(" .")
    return re.sub(r"^(the|a|an)\s+", "", t)


def usable(qframe: Any) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(qframe, dict) or not str(qframe.get("kriya") or "").strip():
        return False
    if not (qframe.get("parsed") or qframe.get("partial")):
        return False
    return str(qframe.get("wh_role") or "") in GAP_ROLES


def _roles_of(frame: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for k in ROLES:
        np = frame.get(k)
        if isinstance(np, dict) and str(np.get("text") or "").strip():
            out.append(np)
            if isinstance(np.get("of"), dict):
                out.append(np["of"])
    return out

    }


def speech_act_score(question: str, reply: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """4.9.241 (plan 229 step 10; Nic: natural conversation): structural Echo for speech acts. The reply is re-read with
    the speech-act lexicon (speech_acts.classify, the same reader as the question) and must be (act) the expected response
    act to each act of the question, in order, (reciprocal) the answer to that act, and (only_the_act) nothing else.
    Each check is measured on the reply; nothing is set to pass. A greeting answered by a fact, or by another act, fails."""
    from rmc_engine_v1.speech_acts import echo as _act_echo

    e = _act_echo(question, reply)
    checks = [{"check": k, "ok": bool(v)} for k, v in e["checks"].items()]
    held = sum(1 for c in checks if c["ok"])
    value = round(held / len(checks), 6)
    return {
        "score": value,
        "min": THRESHOLDS["echo_min"],
        "pass": value >= float(THRESHOLDS["echo_min"]),
        "method": "structural_speech_act",
        "compares": "reply_acts_to_expected_response_acts",
        "output_text": str(reply or "")[:400],
        "structure": {"checks": checks, "held": held, "made": len(checks), "question_acts": e["question_acts"],
                      "expected": e["expected"], "reply_acts": e["reply_acts"], "uses_token_overlap": False},
        "calls_llm": False,
    }

"""4.9.196 storage tiers. PMA §6. Stdlib. No LLM.

Hot → Warm (SPC) → Cold → Deep ghost loop.
The charge is genesis_collapse.spc_charge. This file does not copy the
168-hour formula. Resurrection is phase_coherent_gates. All seven must pass.
A dead path that reaches deep is appended once through dpa_195.
It does not admit. dream_idle stays off.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any

from rmc_engine_v1.dpa_195 import (
    append_dead_path,
    classify,
    empty_archive,
    erase,
    verify_archive,
)
from rmc_engine_v1.drift_v43 import C_MIN, ECHO_MIN
from rmc_engine_v1.genesis_collapse import HALF_LIFE_HOURS, spc_active, spc_charge, spc_gc
from rmc_engine_v1.phase_coherent_gates import phase_coherent_resurrection

CITE = (
    "PMA §6 Hot, Warm (SPC), Cold, Deep ghost loop. "
    "Charge is genesis_collapse.spc_charge, half-life 168 h (Genesis Node pp.116, 143–145). "
    "Active is charge above 0.1. Collection is charge below 0.05. "
    "Hot is the active runtime at elapsed 0 while the charge is still active. "
    "Warm is the SPC while the charge stays active after time has moved. "
    "Cold is not active and not collected. Deep ghost is collection and does not re-enter. "
    "Resurrection is phase_coherent_gates. All seven must pass. "
    "A dead path that reaches deep is appended once through dpa_195. A rewrite is rejected. An erase is rejected. "
    "Codex 0.5, 0.6, and 0.3 cuts are log-only. C_min stays 0.87. Echo stays 0.85. No LLM."
)
TS = "2026-10-30T17:00:00Z"
ORDER = ("hot", "warm", "cold", "deep_ghost")
LABELS = {
    "hot": "Hot",
    "warm": "Warm (SPC)",
    "cold": "Cold",
    "deep_ghost": "Deep ghost loop",
}
CLOCK_HOURS = (0, 168, 600, 800)
INTERNAL = {
    "codex_spc_write": 0.5,
    "codex_cold_entropy": 0.6,
    "codex_resurrect_entropy": 0.3,
    "codex_long_term_drift": 0.3,
    "logged_only": True,
    "admit": False,
    "cite": "Gilligan Codex 3.3, 3.6, 3.7, 3.15. These cuts do not move a tier and do not admit.",
}


def flags() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "admit_gate": False,
        "writes": False,
        "calls_llm": False,
        "money": False,
        "dream_idle": False,
        "economy": False,
        "packs_gated": True,
        "christping": "gilligan-only",
        "wikipedia_anchor": False,
        "c_min": C_MIN,
        "echo_min": ECHO_MIN,
        "internal": INTERNAL,
    }


def _reject(rule: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = {"ok": False, "rule": rule}
    row.update(flags())
    return row


def _num(value: Any):
    try:
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def tier_at(c0: Any, hours: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Read the tier at a simulated hour. Negative time is a rewind."""
    h = _num(hours)
    base = _num(c0)
    if h is None or base is None:
        return _reject("TIER-CLOCK")
    if h < 0 or base < 0:
        return _reject("TIER-CLOCK-REWIND")
    charge = spc_charge(base, h)
    active = bool(spc_active(charge))
    collected = bool(spc_gc(charge))
    if collected:
        name = "deep_ghost"
    elif not active:
        name = "cold"
    elif h <= 0:
        name = "hot"
    else:
        name = "warm"
    row = {
        "ok": True,
        "rule": "TIER-READ",
        "tier": name,
        "label": LABELS[name],
        "charge": charge,
        "hours": h,
        "c0": base,
        "active": active,
        "gc": collected,
        "half_life_hours": HALF_LIFE_HOURS,
        "cite": CITE,
    }
    row.update(flags())
    return row


def empty_store() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"schema": "FORGE-TIERS/v1", "items": [], "moves": [], "archive": empty_archive()}


def _find(store: dict[str, Any], ident: str):
    for item in store["items"]:
        if item["id"] == ident:
            return item
    return None


def _step(body: dict[str, Any]):
    if body.get("from") is None and body.get("to") is None:
        return None
    return {"from": body.get("from"), "to": body.get("to")}


def place(store: dict[str, Any], spec: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body = spec or {}
    ident = body.get("id")
    if not ident:
        return _reject("TIER-FIELDS")
    if _find(store, str(ident)):
        return _reject("TIER-REWRITE-REJECTED")
    base = _num(body.get("c0") if body.get("c0") is not None else 1)
    if base is None or base < 0:
        return _reject("TIER-CHARGE")
    gate = classify(body.get("epsilon_s"), _step(body))
    read = tier_at(base, 0)
    item = {
        "id": str(ident),
        "c0": base,
        "hours": 0,
        "charge": read["charge"],
        "tier": read["tier"],
        "epsilon_s": body.get("epsilon_s"),
        "phase": body.get("phase"),
        "psi": body.get("psi"),
        "ts": body.get("ts"),
        "entropy": body.get("entropy"),
        "from": body.get("from"),
        "to": body.get("to"),
        "dead": gate["dead"],
        "sealed": False,
        "seal_rule": None,
    }
    store["items"].append(item)
    store["moves"].append({"id": item["id"], "hours": 0, "tier": item["tier"], "charge": item["charge"]})
    row = {
        "ok": True,
        "rule": "TIER-PLACED",
        "tier": item["tier"],
        "label": LABELS[item["tier"]],
        "charge": item["charge"],
        "hours": 0,
        "dead": item["dead"],
        "write_allowed": not item["dead"],
        "spc_above_0_5": gate["spc_above_0_5"],
        "spc_logged_only": True,
        "cite": CITE,
    }
    row.update(flags())
    return row


def _seal(store: dict[str, Any], item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    if item.get("psi") is None or item.get("ts") is None or item.get("entropy") is None or item.get("phase") is None:
        item["seal_rule"] = "TIER-UNSEALED"
        return "TIER-UNSEALED"
    spec = {
        "id": item["id"],
        "psi": item["psi"],
        "phase": item["phase"],
        "ts": item["ts"],
        "entropy": item["entropy"],
        "epsilon_s": item["epsilon_s"],
        "reason": "deep-ghost",
    }
    if item.get("from") is not None:
        spec["from"] = item["from"]
    if item.get("to") is not None:
        spec["to"] = item["to"]
    result = append_dead_path(store["archive"], spec)
    if result["ok"]:
        item["sealed"] = True
    item["seal_rule"] = result["rule"]
    return result["rule"]


def advance(store: dict[str, Any], ident: str, hours: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    item = _find(store, str(ident))
    if item is None:
        return _reject("TIER-UNKNOWN")
    h = _num(hours)
    if h is None:
        return _reject("TIER-CLOCK")
    if h < item["hours"]:
        row = _reject("TIER-CLOCK-REWIND")
        row["tier"] = item["tier"]
        row["hours"] = item["hours"]
        return row
    read = tier_at(item["c0"], h)
    moved = read["tier"] != item["tier"]
    item["hours"] = h
    item["charge"] = read["charge"]
    if moved:
        item["tier"] = read["tier"]
        store["moves"].append({"id": item["id"], "hours": h, "tier": item["tier"], "charge": item["charge"]})
    seal_rule = None
    if item["tier"] == "deep_ghost":
        seal_rule = _seal(store, item)
    row = {
        "ok": True,
        "rule": "TIER-MOVED" if moved else "TIER-HELD",
        "tier": item["tier"],
        "label": LABELS[item["tier"]],
        "charge": item["charge"],
        "hours": h,
        "moved": moved,
        "active": read["active"],
        "gc": read["gc"],
        "dead": item["dead"],
        "write_allowed": not item["dead"],
        "seal_rule": seal_rule,
        "archive_n": len(store["archive"]["dead_paths"]),
        "cite": CITE,
    }
    row.update(flags())
    return row


def erase_item(store: dict[str, Any], ident: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    gone = erase()
    row = _reject("TIER-ERASE-REJECTED")
    row["archive_rule"] = gone["rule"]
    row["kept"] = len(store["items"])
    row["id"] = ident
    return row


def passing_record() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "phase": 9,
        "noise_floor": 0.1,
        "chi_threshold": 0.4,
        "identity": "psi-sky",
        "resurrection_log_valid": True,
        "cycle_count": 1,
        "resurrection_limit": 3,
        "capacity_ok": True,
        "active_drift": False,
    }


def resurrect(record: dict[str, Any] | None, tier: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Call the 4.9.191 seven gates. Deep ghost does not re-enter."""
    gates = phase_coherent_resurrection(record if isinstance(record, dict) else {})
    failed = [g["id"] for g in gates["gates"] if not g["pass"]]
    row = {
        "gate_ok": bool(gates["ok"]),
        "gate_count": len(gates["gates"]),
        "passed": sum(1 for g in gates["gates"] if g["pass"]),
        "failed": failed,
        "gates": gates["gates"],
        "tier": tier,
        "cite": gates.get("cite"),
        "module_cite": CITE,
    }
    row.update(flags())
    if tier == "deep_ghost":
        row["ok"] = False
        row["rule"] = "TIER-DEEP-NO-REENTRY"
        return row
    if tier == "hot":
        row["ok"] = False
        row["rule"] = "TIER-HOT-ACTIVE"
        return row
    if tier not in ("warm", "cold"):
        row["ok"] = False
        row["rule"] = "TIER-UNKNOWN"
        return row
    row["ok"] = bool(gates["ok"])
    row["rule"] = "TIER-RESURRECTED" if gates["ok"] else "TIER-GATES-FAILED"
    return row


def _body(ident: str, epsilon_s: float, phase: int, psi: str, **extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = {
        "id": ident,
        "c0": 1,
        "epsilon_s": epsilon_s,
        "phase": phase,
        "psi": psi,
        "ts": TS,
        "entropy": 0.2,
    }
    row.update(extra)
    return row


def clock_demo() -> dict[str, Any]:
    store = empty_store()
    place(store, _body("sky", 0.2, 9, "psi-sky"))
    rows = [advance(store, "sky", h) for h in CLOCK_HOURS]
    rewind = advance(store, "sky", 100)
    gone = erase_item(store, "sky")
    again = place(store, _body("sky", 0.2, 9, "psi-sky"))
    loud = empty_store()
    hot = place(loud, _body("loud", 0.55, 1, "psi-loud"))
    row = {
        "tiers": [r["tier"] for r in rows],
        "hours": list(CLOCK_HOURS),
        "labels": [r["label"] for r in rows],
        "moves": [m["tier"] for m in store["moves"]],
        "half_charge": rows[1]["charge"],
        "active": [r["active"] for r in rows],
        "gc": [r["gc"] for r in rows],
        "clock_seal": rows[3]["seal_rule"],
        "rewind_rule": rewind["rule"],
        "rewind_tier": rewind["tier"],
        "erase_rule": gone["rule"],
        "archive_rule": gone["archive_rule"],
        "kept": gone["kept"],
        "rewrite_rule": again["rule"],
        "length": len(store["items"]),
        "loud_tier": hot["tier"],
        "loud_dead": hot["dead"],
        "loud_spc": hot["spc_above_0_5"],
        "loud_write": hot["write_allowed"],
        "half_life_hours": HALF_LIFE_HOURS,
        "order": list(ORDER),
        "cite": CITE,
    }
    row.update(flags())
    return row


def resurrect_demo() -> dict[str, Any]:
    good = passing_record()
    bad = dict(good)
    bad["phase"] = 8
    cap = dict(good)
    cap["capacity_ok"] = False
    warm = resurrect(good, "warm")
    cold = resurrect(good, "cold")
    deep = resurrect(good, "deep_ghost")
    hot = resurrect(good, "hot")
    fail = resurrect(bad, "warm")
    capacity = resurrect(cap, "warm")
    row = {
        "warm_ok": warm["ok"],
        "warm_rule": warm["rule"],
        "warm_passed": warm["passed"],
        "warm_count": warm["gate_count"],
        "warm_failed": warm["failed"],
        "cold_ok": cold["ok"],
        "cold_rule": cold["rule"],
        "cold_passed": cold["passed"],
        "deep_ok": deep["ok"],
        "deep_rule": deep["rule"],
        "deep_gate_ok": deep["gate_ok"],
        "deep_passed": deep["passed"],
        "hot_ok": hot["ok"],
        "hot_rule": hot["rule"],
        "fail_ok": fail["ok"],
        "fail_rule": fail["rule"],
        "fail_failed": fail["failed"],
        "capacity_ok": capacity["ok"],
        "capacity_failed": capacity["failed"],
        "cite": CITE,
    }
    row.update(flags())
    return row


def deep_demo() -> dict[str, Any]:
    store = empty_store()
    early = place(store, _body("row-36", 0.36, 1, "psi-36"))
    late = advance(store, "row-36", 800)
    again = advance(store, "row-36", 900)
    checked = verify_archive(store["archive"])
    calm = empty_store()
    place(calm, _body("row-35", 0.35, 1, "psi-35"))
    calm_late = advance(calm, "row-35", 800)
    skip_store = empty_store()
    place(skip_store, _body("row-58", 0.1, 8, "psi-58", **{"from": 5, "to": 8}))
    skip_early = advance(skip_store, "row-58", 0)
    skip_late = advance(skip_store, "row-58", 800)
    gone = erase_item(store, "row-36")
    row = {
        "early_tier": early["tier"],
        "early_dead": early["dead"],
        "early_write": early["write_allowed"],
        "late_tier": late["tier"],
        "seal_rule": late["seal_rule"],
        "again_rule": again["seal_rule"],
        "archive_n": again["archive_n"],
        "chain_ok": checked["ok"],
        "phase_name": store["archive"]["dead_paths"][0]["phase_name"],
        "calm_tier": calm_late["tier"],
        "calm_rule": calm_late["seal_rule"],
        "calm_n": calm_late["archive_n"],
        "calm_dead": calm_late["dead"],
        "skip_early_tier": skip_early["tier"],
        "skip_dead": skip_early["dead"],
        "skip_tier": skip_late["tier"],
        "skip_rule": skip_late["seal_rule"],
        "skip_phase": skip_store["archive"]["dead_paths"][0]["phase_name"],
        "skip_n": len(skip_store["archive"]["dead_paths"]),
        "erase_rule": gone["archive_rule"],
        "tier_erase": gone["rule"],
        "kept": gone["kept"],
        "hard_stop_81": classify(0.81)["hard_stop"],
        "hard_stop_80": classify(0.8)["hard_stop"],
        "dead_80": classify(0.8)["dead"],
        "dead_35": classify(0.35)["dead"],
        "dead_36": classify(0.36)["dead"],
        "spc_51": classify(0.51)["spc_above_0_5"],
        "cite": CITE,
    }
    row.update(flags())
    return row


def stage(epsilon_s: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Ask-trace summary. It does not change the admit ε_s."""
    gate = classify(epsilon_s, None)
    now = tier_at(1, 0)
    half = tier_at(1, HALF_LIFE_HOURS)
    row = {
        "tier": now["tier"],
        "half_tier": half["tier"],
        "half_life_hours": HALF_LIFE_HOURS,
        "dead": gate["dead"],
        "spc_above_0_5": gate["spc_above_0_5"],
        "spc_logged_only": True,
        "resurrect_rule": "TIER-RESURRECTED",
        "deep_rule": "TIER-DEEP-NO-REENTRY",
        "order": list(ORDER),
        "cite": CITE,
    }
    row.update(flags())
    return row


def monitor_lines(mode: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if mode == "gates":
        row = resurrect_demo()
        return {
            "attrs": {"mode": "gates", "status": row["warm_rule"], "detail": str(row["warm_passed"]) + "/7"},
            "lines": [
                "Warm resurrection " + row["warm_rule"] + ". Gates passed " + str(row["warm_passed"]) + " of 7.",
                "Cold storage resurrection " + row["cold_rule"] + ". Gates passed " + str(row["cold_passed"]) + " of 7.",
                "A phase of 8 fails " + row["fail_failed"][0] + ". Rule " + row["fail_rule"] + ".",
                "Deep ghost loop is " + row["deep_rule"] + ". The seven gates still ran.",
                "Hot is " + row["hot_rule"] + ". It is not stored.",
                "This card does not write memory. dream_idle stays off. No LLM.",
            ],
        }
    if mode == "deep":
        row = deep_demo()
        return {
            "attrs": {"mode": "deep", "status": row["again_rule"], "detail": "n-" + str(row["archive_n"])},
            "lines": [
                "Drift 0.36 reaches Deep ghost loop and seals " + row["seal_rule"] + ".",
                "A second seal is " + row["again_rule"] + ". Archive length " + str(row["archive_n"]) + ". Chain verifies: " + str(row["chain_ok"]).lower() + ".",
                "Drift 0.35 reaches Deep ghost loop and is " + row["calm_rule"] + ".",
                "Phase 5 to phase 8 is a dead path. The sealed phase is " + row["skip_phase"] + ".",
                "An erase is " + row["erase_rule"] + ". The tier erase is " + row["tier_erase"] + ".",
                "This card does not admit. C_min " + str(C_MIN) + ". No LLM.",
            ],
        }
    row = clock_demo()
    return {
        "attrs": {"mode": "clock", "status": row["tiers"][-1], "detail": row["labels"][-1]},
        "lines": [
            row["labels"][0] + " at 0 hours. The charge is still active.",
            row["labels"][1] + " at 168 hours. Half-life charge is 0.5.",
            row["labels"][2] + " at 600 hours. The charge is not active and is not collected.",
            row["labels"][3] + " at 800 hours. The charge is collected.",
            "A rewind is " + row["rewind_rule"] + ". An erase is " + row["erase_rule"] + ".",
            "Drift 0.55 stays " + row["loud_tier"] + " and does not admit. Codex 0.5 is log only. No LLM.",
        ],
    }


def run(payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = payload or {}
    op = row.get("op") or "clock"
    if op == "tier":
        return tier_at(row.get("c0", 1), row.get("hours", 0))
    if op == "gates":
        return resurrect_demo()
    if op == "deep":
        return deep_demo()
    if op == "stage":
        return stage(row.get("epsilon_s"))
    if op == "monitor":
        return monitor_lines(row.get("mode") or "clock")
    if op == "resurrect":
        return resurrect(row.get("record") or passing_record(), str(row.get("tier") or "warm"))
    return clock_demo()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    print(json.dumps(run(json.load(sys.stdin))))

"""Closed unit table as exact rationals. The factors are the same ones the quantity rules use.
No sentence is read here. A caller supplies a number and a unit name it already parsed."""

from __future__ import annotations

# dimension, factor as a decimal string in the dimension's base (kilogram, metre, second).
_ROWS = (
    ("mass", "0.000001", ("milligram", "mg")),
    ("mass", "0.001", ("gram", "grams", "g")),
    ("mass", "1", ("kilogram", "kilograms", "kg", "kilo")),
    ("mass", "1000", ("tonne", "tonnes")),
    ("mass", "0.028349523125", ("ounce", "ounces", "oz")),
    ("mass", "0.45359237", ("pound", "pounds", "lb", "lbs")),
    ("length", "0.001", ("millimeter", "millimeters", "millimetre", "millimetres", "mm")),
    ("length", "0.01", ("centimeter", "centimeters", "centimetre", "centimetres", "cm")),
    ("length", "1", ("meter", "meters", "metre", "metres", "m")),
    ("length", "1000", ("kilometer", "kilometers", "kilometre", "kilometres", "km")),
    ("length", "0.0254", ("inch", "inches", "in")),
    ("length", "0.3048", ("foot", "feet", "ft")),
    ("length", "0.9144", ("yard", "yards", "yd")),
    ("length", "1609.344", ("mile", "miles", "mi")),
    ("time", "1", ("second", "seconds", "sec", "s")),
    ("time", "60", ("minute", "minutes", "min")),
    ("time", "3600", ("hour", "hours", "hr", "h")),
    ("time", "86400", ("day", "days")),
    ("time", "604800", ("week", "weeks")),
)

# The adjective names the property. The unit's dimension has to be that property's dimension.
# tall is not high, and long is not wide: the same metre does not answer a different property.
PROPERTY = {
    "heavy": ("mass", "heavier_than"),
    "tall": ("length", "taller_than"),
    "long": ("length", "longer_than"),
    "wide": ("length", "wider_than"),
    "high": ("length", "higher_than"),
    "deep": ("length", "deeper_than"),
    "old": ("time", "older_than"),
}


def _dec(text: str) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
    s = str(text or "").strip()
    if not s or s.count(".") > 1:
        return None
    neg = s.startswith("-")
    if neg:
        s = s[1:]
    if not s or not all(ch.isdigit() or ch == "." for ch in s):
        return None
    whole, _, frac = s.partition(".")
    digits = (whole or "0") + frac
    if not digits.isdigit():
        return None
    n, d = int(digits), 10 ** len(frac)
    return (-n, d) if neg else (n, d)


def _mul(a: tuple[int, int], b: tuple[int, int]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    return a[0] * b[0], a[1] * b[1]


def _by_name() -> dict[str, tuple[str, tuple[int, int]]]:
    out = {}
    for dim, factor, names in _ROWS:
        fac = _dec(factor)
        if not fac:
            continue
        for name in names:
            out[name] = (dim, fac)
    return out


_UNIT = _by_name()


def quantity(number: str, unit: str) -> dict[str, str] | None:
    """The number in the dimension's base unit, as a rational. Unknown units are None."""
    row = _UNIT.get(str(unit or "").strip().lower())
    num = _dec(str(number or ""))
    if not row or not num or num[0] < 0:
        return None
    dim, fac = row
    n, d = _mul(num, fac)
    return {"dim": dim, "n": str(n), "d": str(d), "num": str(number).strip(), "unit": str(unit).strip().lower()}


def _cmp(a: dict[str, str], b: dict[str, str]) -> int | None:
    if a.get("dim") != b.get("dim"):
        return None
    try:
        left, right = int(a["n"]) * int(b["d"]), int(b["n"]) * int(a["d"])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return (left > right) - (left < right)


# Inverse words are the declared partners. longer has none, so shorter is not licensed by a length.
_INVERSE = {
    "heavier_than": "lighter_than", "lighter_than": "heavier_than",
    "taller_than": "shorter_than", "shorter_than": "taller_than",
    "wider_than": "narrower_than", "narrower_than": "wider_than",
    "higher_than": "lower_than", "lower_than": "higher_than",
    "deeper_than": "shallower_than", "shallower_than": "deeper_than",
    "older_than": "younger_than", "younger_than": "older_than",
}


def mass_names() -> list[str]:
    """Every name whose dimension is mass. The grammar's bare-unit copula uses this set."""
    return sorted(name for dim, _factor, names in _ROWS if dim == "mass" for name in names)


def licenses(left: dict, right: dict, head: dict) -> bool:
    """Two positive measure atoms of one property license the true comparative, its declared inverse,
    and the two negations. Same property only. A bare length is not tall, wide, or deep."""
    lq = left.get("quantity") if isinstance(left.get("quantity"), dict) else None
    rq = right.get("quantity") if isinstance(right.get("quantity"), dict) else None
    if not lq or not rq or not lq.get("property") or lq.get("property") != rq.get("property"):
        return False
    order = _cmp(lq, rq)
    if order is None or order == 0:
        return False
    hi, lo = (left, right) if order > 0 else (right, left)
    want = PROPERTY.get(str(hi["quantity"].get("property") or ""))
    if not want:
        return False
    cmp_pred, inv = want[1], _INVERSE.get(want[1])
    hi_name = str((hi.get("args") or [""])[0]).lower()
    lo_name = str((lo.get("args") or [""])[0]).lower()
    args = [str(a).lower() for a in head.get("args") or []]
    if len(args) != 2 or args[0] == args[1]:
        return False
    pred, pol = str(head.get("predicate") or ""), str(head.get("polarity") or "pos")
    if pol == "pos" and pred == cmp_pred and args == [hi_name, lo_name]:
        return True
    if pol == "neg" and pred == cmp_pred and args == [lo_name, hi_name]:
        return True
    if inv and pol == "pos" and pred == inv and args == [lo_name, hi_name]:
        return True
    if inv and pol == "neg" and pred == inv and args == [hi_name, lo_name]:
        return True
    return False

"""4.9.234 (plan 229 step 6): RMC and the world model in series.

The orchestrator's RMC pass (coherence, epsilon, route) runs first and is handed to the
world model as its upstream reading. When the world model speaks a derived chain, the
sentence it speaks is measured by the same kernel (measurement_kernel.measure_candidate
and coherence_components), routed by the same containment router, and that reading is
what the Ask gate scores. The orchestrator's other candidate is no longer scored in its place.

A chain is its hops. Each spoken hop is a recalled fact, measured against its own memory row
(the language core measures a recalled fact the same way). The chain's C is its weakest hop.
The conclusion is not a recalled fact: it is admitted by the checker's replay of those hops,
and its drift is measured and gated like every other sentence. Its own lexical C is reported.
The chain's epsilon is the largest epsilon of any spoken sentence. No threshold is read here.
No model is called.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import re
from typing import Any

from rmc_engine_v1.measurement_kernel import coherence_components, measure_candidate

CITE = "source/engine/rmc_engine_v1/world_claim_measure.py measure_spoken"


def _norm(text: Any) -> str:
    return " ".join(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 ]+", " ", str(text or "").lower()).split())


def _sentences(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [s.strip() for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", str(text or "").strip()) if s.strip()]


def _digest(text: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(str(text).encode("utf-8", errors="replace")).hexdigest()[:16]


def upstream_reading(coherence_report: dict[str, Any], routing_packet: dict[str, Any], route_result: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The RMC pass that runs before the world model: its C, epsilon, route and phase path."""
    selected = coherence_report.get("selected_scored_candidate_preview") if isinstance(coherence_report.get("selected_scored_candidate_preview"), dict) else {}
    parts = selected.get("score_components") if isinstance(selected.get("score_components"), dict) else {}
    drift = selected.get("measured_evolutionary_drift") if isinstance(selected.get("measured_evolutionary_drift"), dict) else {}
    try:
        c_value = float(parts.get("coherence_score") if parts.get("coherence_score") is not None else selected.get("coherence_score") or 0.0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        c_value = 0.0
    try:
        eps = float(drift.get("epsilon_s") if drift.get("epsilon_s") is not None else routing_packet.get("epsilon_s") or 0.0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        eps = 0.0
    return {
        "candidate_id": selected.get("candidate_id"),
        "C": round(c_value, 6),
        "epsilon_s": round(eps, 6),
        "route": route_result.get("route"),
        "phase_path": list(routing_packet.get("phase_path") or []),
        "circuit_breaker": bool(drift.get("circuit_breaker")),
        "cite": "deep_dry_run_orchestrator coherence_scorer + containment_router (RMC, before the world model)",
    }


def _premise_node(premise: dict[str, Any], row: dict[str, Any] | None, alignment: dict[str, Any], gate: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The recalled row as the kernel reads a memory node. Every number is the row's own reading."""
    row = row or {}
    gate = gate or {}
    weight = row.get("retrieval_weight")
    weight_basis = "recall.retrieval_weight"
    if weight is None:
        # 4.9.239 (Nic: phase is a retrieval discriminator, not a substitute for semantic evidence). A row recall did
        # not weigh is weighed by what supports it, never by its phase: a premise the frame gate passed (S and C hold)
        # reads 1.0 (basis derive.gate.S·C); otherwise its own context, rpm = μ·e^−ε (resonance_recall._operation_grace,
        # 0 when ε > 0.35 or μ ≤ 0). Before this the weight was cos² of the phase gap (4.9.185) or G = S·C·A (4.9.236),
        # which folded ΔΦ into C. ΔΦ and A are recorded beside the weight as phase_compatibility.
        packet = row.get("packet") if isinstance(row.get("packet"), dict) else None
        if gate.get("passes"):
            weight, weight_basis = 1.0, "derive.gate.S·C"
        elif packet is not None:
            from rmc_engine_v1.resonance_recall import _operation_grace
            g = _operation_grace(packet, alignment.get("question_phi") or 7)
            weight, weight_basis = (float(g.get("rpm") or 0.0) if g.get("aligned") else 0.0), "context.rpm"
        else:
            weight, weight_basis = 0.0, "none"
    phase = None
    try:
        from rmc_engine_v1.resonance_recall import _phase_signal
        phase = _phase_signal((row.get("packet") if isinstance(row.get("packet"), dict) else None) or {"Phi": (gate or {}).get("phi_identity")}, (gate or {}).get("phi_query") or alignment.get("question_phi") or 7)
    except Exception:
        phase = None
    return {
        "memory_id": row.get("memory_id") or premise.get("id"),
        "content": str(premise.get("text") or row.get("content") or "").strip(),
        # The receipt path is ancestry, not compared text (resonance_recall clears these the same way).
        "content_summary": "",
        "summary": "",
        "memory_role": "",
        "source": "",
        "source_path": "",
        "chunk_id": "",
        "symbolic_signature": "",
        "ancestry": row.get("ancestry") or {"premise": premise.get("id")},
        "confidence": "low" if premise.get("quarantined") else (row.get("confidence") or "medium"),
        "retrieval_weight": float(weight or 0.0),
        "retrieval_weight_basis": weight_basis,
        "phase_compatibility": phase,
        "prior_drift_score": row.get("prior_drift_score") or 0.0,
        "phase_tags": list(row.get("phase_tags") or []),
        "packet": row.get("packet") if isinstance(row.get("packet"), dict) else None,
    }


def _measure(text: str, kind: str, nodes: list[dict[str, Any]], phase_path: list[Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    path = [p for p in (phase_path or []) if p] or ["Φ1"]
    candidate = {
        "candidate_id": "wm-" + _digest(text)[:12],
        "title": "",
        "candidate": text,
        "rationale": "",
        "candidate_kind": kind,
        "phase_path": path,
        "phase_target": path[-1],
    }
    measured = measure_candidate(
        candidate, {}, memory_nodes=nodes,
        phase_state={"phase_path_hypothesis": path, "phase_primary": path[0]},
    )
    parts = coherence_components(candidate, measured)
    return {"candidate": candidate, "measured": measured, "parts": parts}


def _route(reading: dict[str, Any], trace_spine: dict[str, Any], structural_drift: dict[str, Any], pf2_preview: dict[str, Any], coherence_report: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from rmc_engine_v1.containment_router import route_candidate
    from rmc_engine_v1.deep_dry_run_orchestrator import _merge_routing_packet
    selected = {
        "candidate_id": reading["candidate_id"],
        "phase_path": reading["phase_path"],
        "coherence_score": reading["C"],
        "score_components": {"coherence_score": reading["C"]},
        "measured_evolutionary_drift": {"epsilon_s": reading["epsilon_s"], "circuit_breaker": reading["circuit_breaker"]},
    }
    packet = _merge_routing_packet(selected, trace_spine, structural_drift, pf2_preview, coherence_report)
    if reading.get("phase_path_basis") == "memory.phase_identity":
        # 4.9.236: the router reads the phase path of what is spoken, the recalled memory in its own phase, not the
        # question text's path from the trace spine (Φ_query is the operation's phase and enters only through G).
        state = dict(packet.get("phase_state") or {}, phase_path_hypothesis=list(reading["phase_path"]))
        packet = dict(packet, phase_state=state, phase_path_hypothesis=list(reading["phase_path"]))
    result = route_candidate(packet)
    return result if isinstance(result, dict) else {}


def measure_spoken(
    reasoning: dict[str, Any],
    observe_rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    phase_path: list[Any],
    upstream: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    trace_spine: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    structural_drift: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    pf2_preview: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    coherence_report: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """The kernel reading of the sentence the world model speaks, or None when it speaks no derived chain."""
    if not isinstance(reasoning, dict) or reasoning.get("applied") is not True:
        return None
    spoken = str(reasoning.get("derived_text") or "").strip()
    derive = reasoning.get("derive") if isinstance(reasoning.get("derive"), dict) else {}
    survivor = derive.get("survivor") if isinstance(derive.get("survivor"), dict) else None
    status = str(derive.get("status") or "")
    if not spoken or survivor is None or status in {"conflicted", "undetermined", ""}:
        return None
    premises = [p for p in (survivor.get("premises") or []) if isinstance(p, dict)]
    if not premises:
        return None
    by_id = {str(r.get("memory_id")): r for r in observe_rows or [] if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("memory_id")}
    # A row resonance locked carries recall's own measured weight on its active node; that reading wins.
    recall_state = ((trace_spine or {}).get("memory_recall") or {}).get("memory_state") or {}
    for node in recall_state.get("active_memory_nodes") or []:
        if isinstance(node, dict) and node.get("memory_id") and node.get("retrieval_weight") is not None:
            mid = str(node["memory_id"])
            base = by_id.get(mid) or {}
            by_id[mid] = dict(node, **{k: v for k, v in base.items() if k not in node})
    # Observe keeps one copy of a repeated sentence; the other copies are the same premise read from another row.
    by_text: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for r in by_id.values():
        by_text.setdefault(_norm(str(r.get("content_summary") or r.get("content") or "")), []).append(r)
    alignment = dict(survivor.get("alignment")) if isinstance(survivor.get("alignment"), dict) else {}
    gate = survivor.get("gate") if isinstance(survivor.get("gate"), dict) else {}
    if gate.get("phi_query") is not None:
        # 4.9.236: a premise's weight is its resonance with the operation's phase (Φ_query), not the question text's
        alignment["question_phi"] = gate["phi_query"]
    nodes = []
    for premise in premises:
        # The same sentence can arrive as several rows (Observe merges them); the row recall measured wins.
        rows = [by_id[str(pid)] for pid in list(premise.get("provenance") or []) + [str(premise.get("id") or "").split(":")[0]] if str(pid) in by_id]
        rows += [r for r in by_text.get(_norm(str(premise.get("text") or "")), []) if r not in rows]
        weighed = [r for r in rows if r.get("retrieval_weight") is not None]
        row = max(weighed, key=lambda r: float(r.get("retrieval_weight") or 0.0)) if weighed else (rows[0] if rows else None)
        nodes.append(_premise_node(premise, row, alignment, gate))

    # A solver receipt's spoken clauses, and a spill chained from a hold, are forms of that premise.
    grounded_forms: set[str] = set()

        forms = [sim.get("effect_text"), sim.get("causal_reason")]
        forms.extend(a.get("text") for a in (sim.get("spoken_atoms") or []) if isinstance(a, dict))
        forms.extend(premise.get("ground_forms") or [])
        for form in forms:
            key = _norm(form)
            if key and key not in premise_by_text:

                grounded_forms.add(key)
    stored_form: dict[str, str] = {}
    if survivor.get("perspective") == "listener":
        # A personal memory is spoken back in the listener's person ("my dog" → "your dog"). That swap is deixis,
        # not content: each sentence is measured in the person it is stored in, and the spoken form is recorded.
        from rmc_engine_v1.world_model_v1 import to_listener
        for stored in [n["content"] for n in nodes if n["content"]] + [str(survivor.get("text") or "")]:
            if stored.strip():
                stored_form[_norm(to_listener(stored))] = stored[:1].upper() + stored[1:]

    if survivor.get("perspective") == "speaker":
        # 4.9.241: a self-fact is stored as the asker says it to the kernel and spoken in the kernel's person; each

        from rmc_engine_v1.world_model_v1 import to_speaker
        for stored in [n["content"] for n in nodes if n["content"]] + [str(survivor.get("text") or "")]:
            if stored.strip():
                stored_form[_norm(to_speaker(stored))] = stored[:1].upper() + stored[1:]
        premise_by_text.update({_norm(to_speaker(n["content"])): n for n in nodes if n["content"]})
    # 4.9.236 (Memory Phase Invariance): a recalled memory is measured in its own phase, Φ_identity (the phase
    # tags its row was stored with), never in the phase of the question's text. ΔΦ to the operation's phase enters
    # only as the premise weight G above. Without a gate (no frame derivation) the question path is kept as before.
    measure_path = list(phase_path or [])
    measure_path_basis = "question.phase_path"

        for n in nodes:
            for tag in n.get("phase_tags") or []:

            if _norm(sentence) in grounded_forms and _norm(measured_as) != _norm(own.get("content")):

            "support": [n["memory_id"] for n in support],
            "C": parts.get("coherence_score"),
            "epsilon_s": measured.get("epsilon_s"),
            "D_score": measured.get("D_score"),
            "sigma_res": measured.get("sigma_res"),
            "delta_phi": (measured.get("phase_metrics") or {}).get("max_delta_phi"),
            "circuit_breaker": bool(measured.get("circuit_breaker")),
            "bounded": bool(measured.get("bounded_evolutionary_drift")),
            "phase_ok": bool((measured.get("phase_metrics") or {}).get("phase_path_legal")),
            "components": {k: parts.get(k) for k in (
                "memory_fit", "phase_validity", "drift_containment", "source_confidence", "utility_fit",
                "bounded_novelty_score", "operator_legality", "conflict_penalty", "projection_gate_penalty", "coherence_score",
            )},
            "formula": parts.get("formula"),
            "drift_terms": dict({k: measured.get(k) for k in ("entropy_norm", "structure_delta", "semantic_distance", "taxonomy_penalty", "novelty_delta")}, D_terms=measured.get("D_terms")),

    hops = [s for s in sentences if s["role"] == "hop"]
    conclusion = [s for s in sentences if s["role"] == "conclusion"]
    # 4.9.243: a Simulate effect reply speaks only the conclusion (no hop sentence in the reply). Measure that
    # conclusion against its causal/state premises so C/ε come from the stored frames, not the orchestrator fallback.
    if not hops:
        how = str(survivor.get("how") or "")
        if conclusion and nodes and (
            survivor.get("kind") == "causal_prediction"
            or how.startswith("WM-CAUSES")
            or how.startswith("WM-IF-THEN")
            or how.startswith("WM-MAKES")
            or how == "WM-SIMULATE"
            or str((survivor.get("frame_match") or {}).get("frame_source") or "") == "simulate"
        ):
            hops = conclusion
        else:
            return None
    weakest = min(hops, key=lambda s: float(s["C"] or 0.0))
    eps = max(float(s["epsilon_s"] or 0.0) for s in sentences)
    breaker = any(s["circuit_breaker"] for s in sentences)
    path = [p for p in (measure_path or []) if p] or ["Φ1"]
    reading = {
        "candidate_id": "wm-" + _digest(spoken)[:12],
        "spoken": spoken,
        "C": round(float(weakest["C"] or 0.0), 6),
        "C_rule": "min over spoken hops (each hop against its own recalled row)",
        "epsilon_s": round(eps, 6),
        "epsilon_rule": "max over every spoken sentence, the conclusion included",
        "sigma_res": max(float(s["sigma_res"] or 0.0) for s in sentences),
        "circuit_breaker": breaker,
        "phase_path": path,
        "phase_path_basis": measure_path_basis,
        "question_phase_path": [p for p in (phase_path or []) if p],
        "phase_ok": all(s["phase_ok"] for s in sentences),
        "checker_ok": bool(survivor.get("checker_ok")),
        "checker_reason": survivor.get("checker_reason"),
        "proof_id": survivor.get("proof_id"),
        "weakest_hop": weakest["text"],
        "weakest_components": weakest["components"],
        "conclusion": conclusion[0] if conclusion else None,
        "sentences": sentences,
        "premises": [{k: n.get(k) for k in ("memory_id", "content", "confidence", "retrieval_weight", "retrieval_weight_basis", "phase_tags", "phase_compatibility")} for n in nodes],
        "upstream": dict(upstream or {}),
        # The kernel's own formula string (measurement_kernel.coherence_components); the weights are unchanged.
        "formula": weakest.get("formula") or "measurement_kernel.coherence_components",
        "calls_llm": False,
        "cite": CITE,

        # An unreplayed conclusion is not admitted by its hops.
        reading["C"] = 0.0
        reading["C_rule"] = "checker did not replay the conclusion"
    if trace_spine is not None:
        route = _route(reading, trace_spine, structural_drift or {}, pf2_preview or {}, coherence_report or {})
        reading["route"] = route.get("route")
        reading["route_reason_codes"] = route.get("reason_codes") or []
        reading["route_result"] = route

def content_tokens(text: str) -> set[str]:
    """Same content-token cut the Ask echo uses in rmc_core._tokens."""
    return {w for w in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", str(text or "").lower()) if len(w) > 2 and w not in _STOP}


def _norm(text: str) -> str:
    token = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(text or "").strip().lower())
    token = re.sub(r"^(the|a|an)\s+", "", token)
    return token.strip(" .")


def _digest(payload: Any) -> str:
    raw = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
    return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _atom(predicate: str, args: list[str], polarity: str = "pos") -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"predicate": predicate, "args": list(args), "polarity": polarity}


def parse_sentence(text: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Contract §7 simple positive or negative fact. Other sentences stay stated."""
    sentence = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(text or "").strip()).strip(" .")
    if not sentence or len(sentence) > LIMITS["MAX_INPUT_CHARS"]:
        return None
    for verb in CLOSED_VERBS:
        match = re.match(r"^(.+?) " + re.escape(verb) + r" (.+)$", sentence, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if not match:
            continue
        subj, obj = match.group(1).strip(), match.group(2).strip()
        if not subj or not obj:
            continue
        polarity = "neg" if verb == "is not" else "pos"
        predicate = "is" if verb == "is not" else verb.lower()
        return {"text": sentence + ".", "atom": _atom(predicate, [subj, obj], polarity), "parsed": True}
    return {"text": sentence + ".", "atom": _atom("stated", [sentence], "pos"), "parsed": False}
